page.notes: The top italic block is a summary or argument line set in italics above the text, and is transcribed as a paragraph. The line "conjugio? Malè" appears to start a new sentence without an indent, so it may be a paragraph break; I kept it in one paragraph. "au-stus" is doubtful: the letters may be "au-ctus" printed with a ligature. "perç-" is the last line; the catchword "eunt" completes the word and is not repeated in the text. The printed "s" is read as a plain s throughout.
